7:20 am, countdown to 16:40:00. Qingchen ran around the community three times. When he came home, he saw Jiang Xue hanging clothes on the clothes rack on the balcony above his house. Every piece of clothing belonged to him. During this period of time, he was so busy with time traveling that he had saved a lot of clothes that he had not washed. The clothes he originally planned to wash yesterday were snatched away by Jiang Xue. When Jiang Xue saw him, she opened the window with a smile and said hello: "Qingchen, I cooked some white porridge, and you just come up to drink it." "No, no, no," Qingchen hurriedly waved his hand, then gnawed on compressed biscuits and went to school. Over the years, he had not seen anyone treat him so well for a long time, so he was not used to it for a while. As soon as he entered the school gate, Qingchen saw many people running towards the high school teaching building. On the way, he met Nan Gengchen who was also running wildly. He asked curiously: "What's wrong?" "Didn't you check the class WeChat group? There is a time traveler in the class next to ours. That guy is in the classroom right now," Nan Gengchen said breathlessly. "Wait a minute, how did you find out that the other person is a time traveler?" Qingchen wondered, no one in the next class had mechanical limbs yesterday. Nan Gengchen said: "He was just showing off. He held it in all day, but he couldn't hold it in when he was chatting with his classmates last night." Qingchen frowned after hearing this. What's going on? There are so many time travelers in Luocheng Foreign Languages ​​School? There are probably more than two thousand people in a school. Among the currently known time travelers, there are four from this school alone. How many are there in the whole country? Even if there are only a dozen or so cities across the country where time travelers appear, the total number of time travelers will not be small. At this time, Qingchen thought that others might also discover the rule he had summarized. By then, will a large number of people from all over the country flock to these dozen cities and hope that they can become one too! ...Thank you to the naughty kid, Qiu Dandan, and Beetle of the Elbow Black Retarded Group for becoming the ally of this book. The boss is generous and the boss is as blessed as the East China Sea and longevity!
